description.text: When you apply for this program, you only need to fill out the department or school in the online application form. Students will choose their specific major opened in this department in the third year. This program belongs to Department of Information Management. Department of Information Management has below majors: Information Management & Information System Library Science Students are required to complete the curriculum between 4 to 6 years and fulfill the designated number of credits. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor’s degree, according to the regulation of the Degree Committee. When to apply early January - early March Please visit cucas for the latest information. Applicants must come in person to Peking University to submit their application materials, or entrust someone else to submit the materials on their behalf. At present, mailed materials are not accepted. Entrance examination dates The written tests is early April. For the details of test venue and time, please refer to your Admission Card. The applicants who pass the written tests are required to attend an interview. Date and venue will be informed after the written tests. Entrance examination subjects Humanities/ Science: Chinese language Mathematics English Admission Admission will be determined according to the applicants' educational background, the results of the Entrance examinations and the interview. The admission result will be available in the end of May. The 'Letter of Admission' and the attached documents can be obtained by the end of June. Registration Period September (specified in the Letter of Admission)

duration.text: The Urban Management at Peking University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, above the age of 18 and under the age of 30, have attained a senior high school diploma.
